title: Green Monster in Magic Garden
description: A surprised green blob-like monster with large eyes and bear ears stands on a patterned stone patio, holding a glowing yellow orb on a stick. The vibrant surreal scene features a winding blue river with orange fish and miniature white temples, set against colorful tiled walls, two large stylized sun and moon faces, a smiling sun in a starry blue sky, and blooming cherry blossom branches.
prompt: A whimsical surreal scene featuring a surprised green blob monster with big round eyes and bear ears standing on a circular patterned stone patio, holding a glowing yellow orb on a stick. A blue river winds through the foreground with orange fish and small white temple structures. The background shows colorful tiled walls with arched doorways, two large stylized sun and moon faces with expressions, a smiling sun in a dark blue starry sky, and flowering cherry blossom branches overhead. Vibrant colors, stained glass aesthetic, intricate linework, fantasy illustration style.
